definitions.gloss: acquisition, mastery, learning (of a skill or knowledge)
definitions.explanation: The process of learning and gaining proficiency in a skill, technique, language, or body of knowledge through study and practice.

notes:
USAGE:
More formal and deliberate than ⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧ (to memorize/learn). {習得|しゅうとく} implies sustained effort and practice leading to real proficiency, while ⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧ is more about memorizing individual facts. Common in educational and professional contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{取得|しゅとく}→取得：11947_shutoku⟧: obtaining (a qualification, license) — focuses on the result
- {修得|しゅうとく}: completing coursework — focuses on academic credits

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{習得|しゅうとく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to acquire a technique
- ⟦{言語|げんご}→言語：02717_gengo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{習得|しゅうとく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to acquire a language
- {習得|しゅうとく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧: to take time to learn
